items.title: Migrate the 3 hand-rolled metadata locks to the shared withMkdirLock primitive
items.context: In packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts (withReviewPassLock ~line 38), review-run.ts (withReviewRunLock ~line 21), and init-check.ts (withInitCheckLock ~line 67): replace each hand-rolled mkdir/deadline/sleep loop with a delegation to withMkdirLock from packages/main/src/core/mkdir-lock.ts, exactly as checklist.ts's withChecklistLock already does. Keep the same lock path (storyFilePath(storyId,'<x>.lock')). Pass a descriptive label (e.g. 'review-passes metadata', 'review-runs metadata', 'init-check metadata'). This raises the acquire budget from 5s to the shared 30s default and restores the documented deadline(30s)>staleMs(10s) invariant. Remove the now-dead local sleepSync helpers if unused. The git commit (autoCommitStoryMetadata) stays inside the critical section (correct per-story commit serialization). Build clean (0 tsc errors).

happy.desc: all 3 handlers delegate to withMkdirLock -> `grep -lE "withMkdirLock\(" packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts packages/main/src/handlers/init-check.ts | wc -l` outputs 3; WHY: each hand-rolled loop is replaced by the shared primitive

no hand-rolled 5s budget remains -> `grep -E "Date.now\(\) \+ 5000" packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts packages/main/src/handlers/init-check.ts | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: the 5s<10s invariant violation is gone
build clean -> `npm --prefix packages/main run build 2>&1 | grep -cE "error TS"` outputs 0; WHY: typechecks

edge.desc: wait-and-poll semantics preserved (no failFastIfHeld) -> `grep -E "failFastIfHeld" packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts packages/main/src/handlers/init-check.ts | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: contention still waits, not fail-fast

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: the shared withMkdirLock primitive itself is unchanged -> `git diff main...HEAD --name-only -- packages/main/src/core/mkdir-lock.ts | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: helper reused not rewritten

items.userSees: `grep -lE "withMkdirLock\(" .../{finding,review-run,init-check}.ts | wc -l` shows 3 and `grep -E "Date.now() + 5000"` shows 0; build clean — all 3 metadata locks now use the shared 30s primitive.

verificationEvidence.note: 3 of 3 handlers now match withMkdirLock( — each hand-rolled loop replaced by the shared primitive
0 matches of Date.now()+5000 — the 5s<10s invariant-violating budget is gone

items.title: Prove the fix retires the B-348d stopgap, then remove the 4 retryOnAnyFailure flags
items.context: Build, then run the four previously-flagged smokes (field-regression-cli, verification-freshness, worktree-repair, review-pass-discard) under heavy parallel load with FAIL-retry DISABLED, i.e. invoke each smoke binary directly (no two-pass runner) with concurrent fillers, for many iterations (>=24 total runs across heavy concurrency), capturing exit codes. Expectation: 0 FAIL. If all pass, remove retryOnAnyFailure:true from those four entries in packages/main/smoke-manifest.json (retire the stopgap). If any one still FAILs under load, KEEP that smoke's flag and record a finding documenting the residual sub-cause. The retryOnAnyFailure mechanism itself (the manifest field + run-all-smokes pass-2 logic from B-348d) is NOT removed - it stays as a general safety net.

happy.desc: all 4 stopgap flags removed -> `grep -c retryOnAnyFailure packages/main/smoke-manifest.json` outputs 0; WHY: stopgap retired after proof
manifest still valid JSON -> `node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('packages/main/smoke-manifest.json','utf8'))" && echo OK` outputs OK; WHY: no corruption

edge.desc: the 4 formerly-flagged smokes pass standalone serial -> `for s in field-regression-cli verification-freshness worktree-repair review-pass-discard; do node packages/main/dist/tasks/$s-smoke.js >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo BAD-$s; done; echo END` outputs only END (no BAD); WHY: each is serially green

adversarial.desc: heavy concurrent --no-retry stress shows 0 FAIL -> `rm -f /tmp/b77ed.tally; for r in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do for s in field-regression-cli verification-freshness worktree-repair review-pass-discard; do (node packages/main/dist/tasks/$s-smoke.js >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $? >>/tmp/b77ed.tally) & done; done; wait; echo FAILS=$(grep -vc '^0$' /tmp/b77ed.tally)` outputs FAILS=0; WHY: proves the lock fix eliminates load-induced FAIL without the retry net

items.userSees: Heavy concurrent --no-retry stress prints FAILS=0 across >=24 runs, and `grep -c retryOnAnyFailure packages/main/smoke-manifest.json` shows 0 — the 4 stopgap flags are retired and the smokes are stable under load without the retry net.
